description: Machine-readable companion to PAPER_CONVENTION.md: the discrete Gaussian noise-synthesis contract for NoiseGenerator.py, equation-ready for Paper 1 Appendix G.

P_k.meaning: one-sided PSD density at rFFT bin k

X_k.meaning: rFFT coefficient at bin k, NumPy/scipy.fft unnormalised convention

interior_bin_sampling: X_k = (Re + i*Im) / sqrt(2) * sqrt(E|X_k|^2), Re,Im ~ N(0,1) i.i.d.
variance_power_definition_note: power_definition='variance' forces the DC bin's stochastic contribution to zero; a nonzero deterministic mean is represented separately via deterministic_mean and excluded from the stochastic PSD.
irfft_normalization: NumPy/scipy.fft unnormalised convention: forward transform unscaled, inverse (irfft) scaled by 1/N.

exact_finite_alternative.notes: circulant: exact for the retained length-N prefix when the circulant embedding is positive semidefinite. dense: exact eigendecomposition of the literal Toeplitz matrix, verified via maximum_covariance_error metadata.

obsolete_sampler_superseded.description: Paper 1 Equation 81: fixed-modulus, random-phase-only bins X_k = sqrt(P_k) * e^{i*phi}, phi ~ Uniform[0, 2*pi).
obsolete_sampler_superseded.defect: Reproduces the correct mean PSD but every realization has identical per-bin power (Rayleigh-modulus degenerate), invalidating chi-square/KS/periodogram-variance distributional statistics.
obsolete_sampler_superseded.replacement: circular_complex_gaussian interior bins as specified above, implemented in NoiseGenerator.sample_stationary_gaussian_from_rfft_power (NoiseGenerator.py:325-368).

custom_psd_scaling_modes.normalize: file treated as a shape; rFFT-grid integral normalized to noise_power
custom_psd_scaling_modes.scale: file density multiplied by psd_scale (defaults to noise_power)
custom_psd_scaling_modes.multiply: backward-compatible alias for 'scale', normalized on config load

known_defect_fixed_2026_07.defect: DC bin used the interior-bin scale (f_s*N*P_k/2) instead of the endpoint scale (f_s*N*P_k), under-scaling DC variance by a factor of 2 while Nyquist was already scaled correctly.
known_defect_fixed_2026_07.fix_commit_note: Fixed in this revision; see tests/test_generate_colored_noise_convention.py for regression gates.
known_defect_fixed_2026_07.noise_generator_py_status: Not affected -- psd_density_to_rfft_power() already implements DC/Nyquist correctly; confirmed by tests/test_paper_convention_gates.py.
